description: Beech E18S c/n BA-306 (ex N75Z, N829K), imported in 1974 by Transporte Aéreo de Magallanes (TAMA) as CC-CAK for the Punta Arenas-Porvenir route; crashed at Porvenir 1 August 1980 and set up as an ornament at the entrance of the Capitán Fuentes Martínez aerodrome, painted white with the painter's invented marks 'CCHV'. Dismantling for transfer to the MNAE was halted by the provincial governor on 19 October 2016 (modocharlie.com); whether it was reassembled at Porvenir or later moved is unknown and it does not appear in MNAE photographs.
